description: This file defines a provider for image generation using the 'fal' model, including functions for network policy resolution, image size parsing, and the main image generation logic with HTTP requests and response handling.

methods.name: _setFalFetchGuardForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom fetch implementation for testing purposes.

methods.name: mergeSsrFPolicies
methods.description: Merges multiple SSRF policies into one, combining their rules.

methods.name: matchesTrustedHostSuffix
methods.description: Checks if a hostname matches a trusted suffix.

methods.name: resolveFalNetworkPolicy
methods.description: Resolves network policies based on the base URL and private network allowance.

methods.name: ensureFalModelPath
methods.description: Ensures the model path includes the correct subpath for editing if needed.

methods.name: parseSize
methods.description: Parses a size string like '1024x1024' into width and height numbers.

methods.name: mapResolutionToEdge
methods.description: Maps resolution labels ('1K', '2K', '4K') to pixel edge values.

methods.name: aspectRatioToEnum
methods.description: Converts aspect ratio strings to predefined enum labels.

methods.name: aspectRatioToDimensions
methods.description: Calculates width and height from aspect ratio and edge size.

methods.name: resolveFalImageSize
methods.description: Determines the image size configuration based on input parameters.

methods.name: toDataUri
methods.description: Converts a Buffer and MIME type to a data URI string.

methods.name: fileExtensionForMimeType
methods.description: Returns file extension based on MIME type.

methods.name: fetchImageBuffer
methods.description: Fetches an image from a URL, returning its buffer and MIME type, with trust policy checks.

methods.name: buildFalImageGenerationProvider
methods.description: Constructs and returns the image generation provider object for 'fal'.
